sources.title: Afghanistan entry requirements
sources.officialityEvidence: FCDO's live guidance expressly applies to travellers using a full British citizen passport from the United Kingdom and describes Afghanistan's current entry rule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A visa is required to enter Afghanistan. The Afghan embassy in London is closed.

sources.title: Israel entry requirements
sources.officialityEvidence: FCDO's current page expressly covers Israel and Palestine for full British citizen passports and identifies Israeli control of entry to Palestine and distinct Gaza restrictions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The Israeli authorities control entry to Palestine, including by sea to Gaza.

unresolved.reason: Current FCDO guidance says a visa is required, but the Afghan Embassy in London is closed and no ordinary British-citizen visitor issuance channel or timing is established. No route is inferred.

Current FCDO Israel-and-Palestine guidance is route- and territory-specific: Israeli authorities control entry to Palestine, West Bank crossing requires Israeli entry documentation, and Gaza has separate restrictions. No destination-wide status is established.
